006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.AbstractNodeItemVisitor;
009
010import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
011
012/**
013 * Provides a set of callbacks used when iterating over model elements in a
014 * directed graph.
015 * <p>
016 * The {@link AbstractNodeItemVisitor} provides an abstract implementation of
017 * this visitor pattern.
018 *
019 * @param <CONTEXT>
020 *          the type of contextual data to pass to each visited node
021 * @param <RESULT>
022 *          the type of result produced by visitation
023 * @see AbstractModelElementVisitor
024 */
025public abstract class AbstractModelElementVisitor<CONTEXT, RESULT> implements IModelElementVisitor<CONTEXT, RESULT> {
026  /**
027   * Produce a default result for the provided element and contextual information.
028   *
029   * @param element
030   *          the element the result is for
031   * @param context
032   *          the contextual information provided by the visitor.
033   * @return the result
034   */
035  protected abstract RESULT defaultResult(@NonNull IModelElement element, CONTEXT context);
036
037  @Override
038  public RESULT visitFlagInstance(IFlagInstance item, CONTEXT context) {
039    // do nothing
040    return defaultResult(item, context);
041  }
042
043  @Override
044  public RESULT visitFieldInstance(IFieldInstanceAbsolute item, CONTEXT context) {
045    // do nothing
046    return defaultResult(item, context);
047  }
048
049  @Override
050  public RESULT visitFieldInstance(IFieldInstanceGrouped item, CONTEXT context) {
051    // do nothing
052    return defaultResult(item, context);
053  }
054
055  @Override
056  public RESULT visitAssemblyInstance(IAssemblyInstanceAbsolute item, CONTEXT context) {
057    // do nothing
058    return defaultResult(item, context);
059  }
060
061  @Override
062  public RESULT visitAssemblyInstance(IAssemblyInstanceGrouped item, CONTEXT context) {
063    // do nothing
064    return defaultResult(item, context);
065  }
066
067  @Override
068  public RESULT visitChoiceInstance(IChoiceInstance item, CONTEXT context) {
069    // do nothing
070    return defaultResult(item, context);
071  }
072
073  @Override
074  public RESULT visitChoiceGroupInstance(IChoiceGroupInstance item, CONTEXT context) {
075    // do nothing
076    return defaultResult(item, context);
077  }
078
079  @Override
080  public RESULT visitFlagDefinition(IFlagDefinition item, CONTEXT context) {
081    // do nothing
082    return defaultResult(item, context);
083  }
084
085  @Override
086  public RESULT visitFieldDefinition(IFieldDefinition item, CONTEXT context) {
087    // do nothing
088    return defaultResult(item, context);
089  }
090
091  @Override
092  public RESULT visitAssemblyDefinition(IAssemblyDefinition item, CONTEXT context) {
093    // do nothing
094    return defaultResult(item, context);
095  }
096}
